counterfactual_missing_items: No evidence of active tuberculosis on biopsy or imaging
Splenic biopsy shows lymphoma, not granulomatous inflammation
CD10− and mum-1+ pattern favors activated B-cell subtype
decisive_items: CD20+, Pax5+, BcL-2+, BcL-6+, CD10−, mum-1+, Cmyc+ (40%)
response.rationale: C1 provides the most specific diagnosis (ABC-type DLBCL) directly supported by the IHC profile (CD10−, mum-1+, Cmyc+ 40%, CD30+) and splenic lesions. R1 is the broader DLBCL diagnosis, subsumed by C1. R4 is contradicted by the biopsy-proven lymphoma and lack of TB-specific findings.

rejected.why: History of tuberculosis is non-specific and contradicted by splenic biopsy showing B-cell lymphoma with CD20+, Pax5+, and high Ki67, not granulomatous disease.
